notes: Found live that the Feature Adoption Matrix's QoS column always showed '-' for every system -- confirmed via live GraphQL schema introspection that Active IQ's API has no QoS field at all. Replaced QoS everywhere with AutoSupport configuration status, a real field populated on 99.8% of a real fleet with genuine variance. Also fixed a real accuracy bug where HA and SnapMirror defaulted to false/0 (not null) when a system wasn't part of any cluster Active IQ returned, making 'not reported' indistinguishable from 'confirmed disabled' -- StorageGRID/E-Series and ungrouped systems were showing a false negative. Added 6 more Success Plan templates explicitly framed around TAM (AutoSupport Connectivity Restoration, MetroCluster Health Remediation, Hardware Firmware Currency), SAM (Contract Co-Termination Opportunity, Licensed Feature Utilization Gap), and MSP (Remediation SLA Compliance Recovery) account-planning angles, for 18 total.
